description: Synthetic NCBI-derived SYK-6 ligAB was expressed from pET15b in E. coli BL21; alpha was initially N-His-tagged and beta was untagged. Anaerobic purification included thrombin cleavage (P8–P16). 2,3,4-trihydroxybenzoic acid reduced PCA-dependent O2 consumption by 95% with 500 µM PCA, 1 mM inhibitor and 3–7 nM LigAB in air-saturated 50 mM Tris, pH 7.5, 25°C (Table2b/P27). This does not establish a competitive Ki or inhibition of gallate flux. The chemical endpoint follows the neutral parent drawn in SI FigureS2; supplied salt and unique assay microspecies are not assigned.
